name: conclave
description: Manage Conclave-SDK kits and edit the reviewer pin of the current repository.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode Conclave runs no process: no dispatcher, no Python and no forge.py until the workspace is trusted.

conclave.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Python 3.11 or later that runs the workspace's `scripts/review-dispatch.py` and `forge.py`. Empty: `py -3` then `python` on Windows, `python3` then `python` elsewhere, found on `PATH` only. A set but unusable path is an error; discovery is not tried in its place.

conclave.sdkPath.markdownDescription: For working on Conclave-SDK itself: a local checkout (holding `forge.py` and `kits/`) to read kits from instead of the SDK bundled in the extension. Leave it empty otherwise. A set path that is not a checkout is an error, not a fall-back.

scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run build && vscode-test
